level_domain_producers./api/liquidity-snapshot: CARRIER, not a producer (Phase 2A): serves liquidity engine raw levels by carrying the /api/levels PriceLevelSnapshot values unchanged, under the same generation. It formerly re-invoked the same engine helpers over its own synchronous vendor bar fetch, which is how it served overnight 773.40/772.55 against the levels endpoint's 773.3975/773.3975 at one instant.
